behaviors.description: Persist descriptor-supplied environment entries when finalizing a build.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent unfinalized build trees and two distinct NUL-separated descriptor payloads.
behaviors.expected: Each public metadata file contains exactly the supplied environment values, including empty strings and spaces/equal signs.

mappings.rationale: Independently supplied descriptor bytes become exact public metadata fields in two fresh trees.

surface_assertions.rationale: Finalized metadata distinguishes both input payloads and retains empty values.
